---
title: "North America"
subtitle: "Top 100 researchers based in North America"
date: today
date-format: "MMMM YYYY"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
top100 <- read.csv("../../out/gb_top100_v02.csv",
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                   fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
NA_COUNTRIES <- c("US", "CA", "MX")
na_pts <- top100 %>%
  filter(country %in% NA_COUNTRIES) %>%
  arrange(merged_rank)
```

`r nrow(na_pts)` Top 100 researchers are based in North America (US, Canada, Mexico).

::: {.column-page}
![](../../out/11_top100_north_america.png){fig-alt="Map of North American Top 100 researchers"}
:::

## Listing

```{r na-table}
display <- na_pts %>%
  transmute(
    Rank        = merged_rank,
    Name        = name,
    Institution = institution,
    Country     = country
  )
DT::datatable(
  display,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = 'fltip',
                 order = list(list(0, 'asc'))),
  class = 'compact stripe hover'
)
```
